name: The Owner's Manual
display_message: You actually read it. All gear in inventory and equipped is immediately identified. Nobody does this voluntarily.

name: The Original Receipt
display_message: Proof of purchase, wielded against the supernatural. Removes all hindering enchantments from equipped gear. The item sighs in resignation.

name: Goop-Gone (Curse Remover)
display_message: Industrial-strength enchantment solvent. Dissolves hindering affixes on contact. Also removes grease from ceramic tile. The directions warned against this use.

name: Sticky Note of Identification
display_message: A yellow sticky note with an arrow on it. Applied to any unidentified gear to immediately reveal its true nature. Did not come with the gear. Nothing comes with the gear.

name: YallTube DIY Video
display_message: A printout of a four-minute video titled 'How To Do That One Thing.' Reveals one crafting recipe permanently. Comments are disabled. Correctly.

name: The Book of REAL Men
display_message: A thick paperback about how a man should stand, walk, and feel emotions incorrectly. No mechanical effect. I guess someone might find this useful.

name: The Sigma Grindset (Audiobook)
display_message: 7 CDs. Covers 'winning' and 'not losing.' Mutually exclusive with reading. No mechanical effect. I guess someone might find this useful.

name: Mindfulness Journal for Gentle Men
display_message: Prompts include 'What did I apologize for today?' No mechanical effect. I guess someone might find this useful.

name: ALPHA MASS SUPPLEMENT
display_message: 97% maltodextrin. Comes with a poster of a man who also takes this. No mechanical effect. I guess someone might find this useful.

name: 'I Feel Things' Button
display_message: Enamel pin. He does feel things. Mostly his back. No mechanical effect. I guess someone might find this useful.

name: Free Gym Trial Membership (30 Days)
display_message: ATTR BOOST: +2 permanent ATK. The 30 days is real. The gains are permanent. The membership is not renewed.

name: A History of Rome (Unabridged)
display_message: ATTR BOOST: +1 permanent Dadism power. 847 pages. He read 400. That was enough. He has opinions now.

name: Crossword Book (Pen, Not Pencil)
display_message: ATTR BOOST: +1 permanent PER. Ink only. No erasing. He commits to his guesses. Several of them are wrong. He knows.

name: Complete Toolbox (Labeled)
display_message: ATTR BOOST: +2 permanent DEF. Every tool in its place. All labeled. He knows exactly where the 10mm socket is. He is not sharing this information.

name: Garage Bowling Ball (One Of A Pair)

name: Rusted Horseshoe

name: Frozen Burger Patty (Single)
display_message: throwable(5)  Throwable (5 dmg). A discus of regret. Thaws on impact, mostly onto the target.

name: Range Bucket Golf Ball
display_message: throwable(4)  Throwable (4 dmg, long range). He has a whole bucket of these. Nobody knows why. He knows why.

name: Wrinkled Dadism Scroll
display_message: A laminated printout discovered in a coat pocket, dated 1998. Teaches a random Dadism you don't already know. He made seventeen copies. Each is slightly different. He does not know which one this is.
